_comment: Bundled emergency-service numbers, available offline from first launch. Admins can override them via the portal (published/emergency). The verification block records what was checked and when — the owner MUST confirm these with official Maharashtra / Sangli district sources before release and then set status to 'verified'.

verification.note: 112 is India's integrated Emergency Response Support System number; 100 is the legacy police number being integrated into 112. Official 112.gov.in could not be reached during the check; confirmed only via state police pages.
108 is the Maharashtra Emergency Medical Services (MEMS) ambulance number per state police and news sources; 112 also routes medical emergencies.
101 is the legacy fire & rescue number listed by MHA-linked ERSS references as being integrated into 112.
